question: Estimate the annual revenue of MakeMyTrip (Indian operations).
idealClarificationQuestions: MMT + Goibibo + redBus (all MMT-owned brands)? Yes.
Net revenue (commission + service fees) or gross bookings? Provide both.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: MMT gross bookings FY26: ~$10-11B (~₹85,000 Cr) — leader in OTA.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Take rate (commissions + service fees + ad revenue)
Plus advertising / payment processing fees / B2B (myBiz)

calculationFlow: MMT gross bookings FY26: ~$10-11B (~₹85,000 Cr) — leader in OTA.
Take rate (commissions + service fees + ad revenue): ~6-8% (varies by segment; hotels 12-15%, flights 5-6%, packages 10-12%).
Plus advertising / payment processing fees / B2B (myBiz): ~₹500-700 Cr.
